query:
INSERT INTO repositories (
                host,
                host_id,
                name,
                description,
                last_commit,
                stars,
                forks,
                issues,
                updated_at,
                override_build_priority
             )
             VALUES (
                'github.com',
                $1,
                $2,
                'Fake description!',
                NOW(),
                $3,
                $4,
                $5,
                NOW(),
                $6
             )
             RETURNING id
